title: Filter a long list
description:
Write the matching a filter box above a long list uses, and the list it produces:

```cpp
bool matches(const std::string& item, const std::string& filter);
std::vector<int> visibleItems(const std::vector<std::string>& items, const std::string& filter);
int keepSelection(const std::vector<int>& visible, int selected);
```

- `matches`: split the filter into words at spaces. The item matches if **every** word appears somewhere in it, in any order, ignoring upper and lower case. An empty filter (or one with only spaces) matches everything.
- `visibleItems`: the indexes of the matching items, in order.
- `keepSelection`: after the filter changes, keep the selected item if it is still visible; otherwise select the first visible item; if nothing is visible, return `-1`.

```
matches("big_mossy_rock", "rock BIG") == true
matches("big_mossy_rock", "rock small") == false
```
